```yaml
name: FATFS Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test-fatfs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake git libssl-dev libz-dev dosfstools

      - name: Build wolfssh and FATFS example
        run: |
          make
          make -C examples/fatfs

      - name: Create FATFS image
        run: |
          dd if=/dev/zero of=fatfs.img bs=1M count=10
          mkfs.fat -F 32 fatfs.img

      - name: Mount FATFS image and create test file
        run: |
          LOOPDEV=$(losetup -fP --show fatfs.img)
          sudo mount $LOOPDEV /mnt
          echo "Hello world" | sudo tee /mnt/testfile.txt > /dev/null
          sudo umount /mnt
          sudo losetup -d $LOOPDEV

      - name: Start FATFS server
        run: |
          ./examples/fatfs/server -i fatfs.img -p 2222 &
          echo $! > server.pid
        shell: bash

      - name: Wait for server to start
        run: sleep 5

      - name: Run wolfsftp client to get file
        run: |
          ./examples/fatfs/client -s localhost -p 2222 -u test -pw test -get testfile.txt -o downloaded.txt
        shell: bash

      - name: Verify downloaded file
        run: |
          diff testfile.txt downloaded.txt

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f server.pid ]; then
            kill $(cat server.pid) || true
          fi
```
